cur:objects-berlin-crucifixion-with-sold.summary: Christ is crucified high in the upper part of the panel, with mourning angels above the cross. Below, the Virgin and the holy women stand at the left, while at the right a group of helmeted soldiers gathers. The fuller, more narrative version of Calvary contrasts the sorrow of the faithful with the indifference of the executioners.
facts: Byzantine ivory carvers produced both the simple three-figure Crucifixion and fuller narrative versions with soldiers and mourners, sometimes in the same workshop (type).
